items: Calcium carbonate aur calcium hydroxide tezaabi mitti mein pH barhane (tezaabiyat khatam karne) ke liye dale jate hain taa ke mitti faslon ke liye behtar ho.
Calcium aur magnesium paudon ke zaroori ghizai ajza hain: calcium cell wall ki nashonuma ke liye zaroori aur magnesium chlorophyll ka markazi atom hai jo photosynthesis ke liye ahem hai.
Calcium nitrate aur magnesium sulphate (Epsom salts) jaise compounds khaad ke taur par use ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Choone ke pathar se quicklime banane ka mua'adla likhein, aur CaCO3 ka aik zarai istemal us ki kimiya ke saath batayein.
blocks.explanation: Garam karne par CaCO3(s) -> CaO(s) + CO2(g). CaCO3 tezaabi mitti mein dala jata hai: base ke taur par yeh tezaab khatam kar ke pH barhata hai.

items: CaCO3 aur Ca(OH)2 tezaabi mitti ko neutral karte.
Ca cell walls ke liye, Mg chlorophyll mein; calcium nitrate aur Epsom salts khaad.
